Common Cold.Description: A common viral infection affecting the nose and throat.
Prevention: Avoid close contact with infected people

Influenza (Flu).Description: Influenza is a viral respiratory infection that affects the lungs and breathing system.

Diabetes.Description: A metabolic disorder where blood glucose levels remain higher than normal.

Asthma.Description: A chronic respiratory condition causing difficulty in breathing due to airway narrowing.

Migraine.Description: A neurological condition causing severe recurring headaches.

COVID-19.Description: A viral infection caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus that can affect the respiratory system.
Causes: Close contact with an infected person
Prevention: Stay up to date with recommended vaccination
Warning Signs: Confusion or unusual difficulty staying awake

Pneumonia.Description: An infection of the lungs that can cause inflammation and difficulty breathing.
Causes: Aspiration of material into the lungs
Warning Signs: Blue or gray lips or face

Hypertension.Description: A condition in which blood pressure remains higher than the healthy range over time.
Prevention: Balanced diet with appropriate sodium intake
Warning Signs: Severe headache with other concerning symptoms

Food Poisoning.Description: Illness caused by consuming food or drinks contaminated with harmful organisms or toxins.
Care: Seek medical advice when symptoms are severe or persistent
Warning Signs: Persistent vomiting or severe abdominal pain

Gastritis.Description: Inflammation of the lining of the stomach.
Causes: Excess alcohol or other stomach irritants
Prevention: Discuss recurring symptoms with a clinician

Skin Allergy.Description: An allergic reaction involving the skin, often causing itching or a rash.

Dermatitis.Description: Inflammation of the skin that may cause itching, redness, or irritation.

Conjunctivitis.Description: Inflammation or infection of the conjunctiva, the surface covering part of the eye.
Care: Avoid contact lenses while symptomatic unless advised otherwise

Ear Infection.Description: An infection or inflammation affecting part of the ear.

Arthritis.Description: A group of conditions that cause joint inflammation, pain, or stiffness.
Warning Signs: Fever with a hot swollen joint

Urinary Tract Infection.Description: An infection affecting part of the urinary system.
Causes: Urinary retention or other risk factors
Warning Signs: Fever with back or side pain

Anxiety Disorder.Description: A group of mental health conditions involving excessive or persistent anxiety that can interfere with daily life.
Care: Talk with a trusted adult or mental-health professional
Follow a care plan if provided
Warning Signs: Symptoms severely interfering with daily activities

Depression.Description: A mental health condition involving persistent low mood or loss of interest that can affect daily functioning.
Prevention: Seek help early when symptoms persist
Care: Talk to a trusted adult or mental-health professional
Warning Signs: Unable to manage normal daily activities

Thyroid Disorder.Description: A condition in which the thyroid gland produces too much or too little thyroid hormone.
Causes: Certain medicines or other medical factors
Care: Follow thyroid testing and treatment plans

Anemia.Description: A condition in which the blood does not carry enough oxygen because of reduced red blood cells or hemoglobin.

Dengue.Description: A viral illness transmitted mainly by infected mosquitoes.

Malaria.Description: A serious mosquito-borne disease caused by Plasmodium parasites.
Prevention: Use recommended malaria prevention when traveling to risk areas

Chickenpox.Description: A contagious viral infection commonly causing an itchy blister-like rash and fever.
Prevention: Avoid close contact with infected people

Tuberculosis.Description: An infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, most often affecting the lungs.
Causes: Airborne spread from an infectious person

Heart Disease.Description: A broad term for conditions affecting the heart or its blood vessels.

Bronchitis.Description: Inflammation of the bronchial tubes that can cause cough and breathing discomfort.

Sinusitis.Description: Inflammation of the sinuses that may cause facial pressure, congestion, and nasal symptoms.

Food Allergy.Description: An immune reaction to a particular food that can range from mild to severe.
Causes: Immune reaction to specific food proteins
Care: Seek urgent help for severe reactions

Kidney Stone.Description: A hard deposit that forms in the kidneys and may cause severe pain when passing through the urinary tract.
Prevention: Address risk factors with a clinician

Kidney Infection.Description: An infection affecting one or both kidneys, often developing from a urinary tract infection.
Causes: Urinary blockage or other risk factors

Liver Disease.Description: A broad term for conditions that affect the structure or function of the liver.
Causes: Certain medicines, toxins, or inherited disorders

Hepatitis.Description: Inflammation of the liver caused by infections, immune conditions, or other factors.

Eye Infection.Description: An infection affecting part of the eye or surrounding tissues.
Prevention: Avoid sharing towels or eye products

Glaucoma.Description: A group of eye conditions that can damage the optic nerve, often associated with increased eye pressure.

Alzheimer Disease.Description: A health condition involving the alzheimer disease.
Causes: Various biological, environmental, or lifestyle factors
Prevention: Seek medical advice when symptoms persist
Warning Signs: Seek urgent medical care for serious symptoms

Parkinson Disease.Description: A health condition involving the parkinson disease.
Causes: Various biological, environmental, or lifestyle factors
Prevention: Seek medical advice when symptoms persist
Warning Signs: Seek urgent medical care for serious symptoms

Epilepsy.Description: A neurological condition characterized by a tendency to have recurrent seizures.

Obesity.Description: A health condition involving excess body fat that may increase the risk of other health problems.
Care: Seek guidance from a healthcare professional

Typhoid.Description: A bacterial infection caused by Salmonella Typhi, commonly spread through contaminated food or water.

Measles.Description: A highly contagious viral infection that can cause fever and a widespread rash.

Mumps.Description: A contagious viral infection that commonly causes swelling of the salivary glands.
Prevention: Avoid close contact with infected people

Bronchial Asthma.Description: A chronic condition in which the airways become inflamed and narrowed, causing breathing symptoms.

COPD.Description: A chronic lung disease that causes persistent airflow limitation and breathing difficulty.

Sleep Apnea.Description: A sleep disorder in which breathing repeatedly stops or becomes restricted during sleep.
Prevention: Discuss risk factors with a clinician
Warning Signs: Breathing pauses with severe daytime sleepiness

Insomnia.Description: A sleep problem involving difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or getting restful sleep.

Panic Disorder.Description: A mental health condition involving recurrent unexpected panic attacks and ongoing concern or avoidance.

Osteoporosis.Description: A condition in which bones become weaker and more likely to fracture.
Warning Signs: Loss of height or posture changes

Gout.Description: A form of inflammatory arthritis caused by buildup of uric acid crystals in joints.
Causes: Certain foods, medicines, or health conditions
Care: Rest an affected joint during flares
Warning Signs: Sudden severe joint pain and swelling
Fever with a hot swollen joint

PCOS.Description: A hormonal condition associated with irregular periods, androgen-related symptoms, and changes in ovarian function.
Prevention: Discuss menstrual irregularities with a clinician
Care: Maintain regular activity and balanced nutrition

Urinary Infection.Description: A health condition involving the urinary infection.
Causes: Various biological, environmental, or lifestyle factors
Prevention: Seek medical advice when symptoms persist
Warning Signs: Seek urgent medical care for serious symptoms

Kidney Failure.Description: A serious condition in which the kidneys can no longer adequately perform their normal functions.
Causes: Severe injury or other medical conditions
Prevention: Manage blood pressure and other risks
Attend medical checkups when at risk
Care: Follow fluid and diet guidance when given

Appendicitis.Description: Inflammation of the appendix that can cause worsening abdominal pain and requires prompt medical evaluation.
Prevention: There is no reliable way to prevent all cases
Seek evaluation for worsening abdominal pain

Irritable Bowel Syndrome.Description: A digestive disorder causing recurring abdominal pain with changes in bowel habits.
Care: Keep a symptom and food record
Seek medical advice for persistent symptoms

Migraine Chronic.Description: A neurological disorder involving frequent recurring migraine headaches and associated symptoms.

Skin Infection.Description: An infection affecting the skin or tissues beneath it.

Eczema.Description: A group of conditions causing dry, itchy, and inflamed skin.

Psoriasis.Description: A chronic inflammatory skin condition that can cause thick, scaly patches.

Gallstones.Description: Hardened deposits that can form in the gallbladder.

GERD.Description: A digestive condition in which stomach contents repeatedly flow back into the esophagus.
Causes: Weakness of the lower esophageal sphincter
Care: Follow recommended meal and sleep habits

Peptic Ulcer.Description: An open sore that develops in the lining of the stomach or upper small intestine.

Chronic Kidney Disease.Description: Long-term damage or reduced function of the kidneys.
Prevention: Manage blood pressure and blood sugar

Pneumothorax.Description: A condition in which air enters the space around a lung and can cause the lung to partially or completely collapse.
Causes: Sometimes occurs without an obvious cause
Prevention: Follow medical advice after previous episodes

Lung Infection.Description: An infection affecting the lungs or lower respiratory tract.

Throat Infection.Description: An infection or inflammation affecting the throat.

Tonsillitis.Description: Inflammation or infection of the tonsils, often causing sore throat and difficulty swallowing.
Prevention: Avoid close contact with sick people

Bipolar Disorder.Description: A mental health condition involving episodes of significant mood changes, including elevated or unusually energized periods and depressive periods.
Prevention: Early professional support for mood changes
Warning Signs: Severe mood changes disrupting daily life

Vitamin Deficiency.Description: A condition caused by not having enough of one or more essential vitamins.

Eye Strain.Description: Eye discomfort or fatigue that can occur after prolonged visual tasks.
Causes: Long periods of screen or close work

Cataract.Description: A clouding of the eye's natural lens that can reduce vision.
Prevention: Protect eyes from injury and excessive sunlight
Care: Discuss treatment options with an eye professional

Fungal Infection.Description: An infection caused by fungi affecting the skin, nails, or other body areas.
Prevention: Wear appropriate footwear in communal areas

Dengue Fever.Description: A health condition involving the dengue fever.
Causes: Various biological, environmental, or lifestyle factors
Prevention: Seek medical advice when symptoms persist
Warning Signs: Seek urgent medical care for serious symptoms

Malaria Fever.Description: A health condition involving the malaria fever.
Causes: Various biological, environmental, or lifestyle factors
Prevention: Seek medical advice when symptoms persist
Warning Signs: Seek urgent medical care for serious symptoms

Common Allergy.Description: An immune-system reaction to a normally harmless substance such as pollen, dust, or certain foods.
Prevention: Identify and reduce exposure to triggers

Heat Stroke.Description: A medical emergency in which the body becomes dangerously overheated.
Prevention: Avoid strenuous activity during extreme heat
Care: Follow first-aid guidance while waiting for help

Dehydration.Description: A condition in which the body loses more fluid than it takes in.
Prevention: Replace fluids during illness or heat
Care: Rest and cool down when overheated
